home.heading: Building an AI agent harness and
home.intro: I’m Michael Lvov. My current project is a self-hosted AI agent harness: one AI Coordinator plans and delegates work, retrieves retained knowledge, selects model routes and combines results.

founders.name: Michael Lvov
founders.bio: I’m a Principal Software Engineer with 20+ years building distributed systems and real-time data platforms in financial services, healthcare and e-commerce at Capital One, Amazon, Aetion and Flatiron Health. My work spans fault-tolerant streaming, petabyte-scale ingestion and clinical ML/NLP integration. I work across architecture, implementation and production reliability.
founders.background: At Nora SuperIntelligence Lab, I built a self-hosted AI agent harness centered on an AI coordinator. Its Coordination runtime connects an OSS Deep Agent, Retrieval MCP tools and LangGraph/PostgreSQL conversation state. Docling, shared BGE and Qdrant support document preparation and dense/lexical retrieval; browser and MCP clients use the same operation. I added bounded context and tool calls, model route selection, and versioned artifact review against source evidence. The architecture separates prepared role judges, Synthetic Owner scoring and Real Owner approval.
outcomes: At Capital One, I led performance and reliability work within a broader streaming modernization that increased throughput from 1,000+ to 3,000+ TPS and reduced infrastructure cost by 30%.

At Capital One, I built AI-assisted diagnostic and configuration workflows connected to monitoring, CI/CD and ticketing. They reduced diagnostic time and manual effort by 90% and shortened tuning cycles from days to hours, with engineers verifying changes.

At Aetion, I built a petabyte-scale healthcare data lake and a DSL/SQL customization engine so client teams could tailor pipelines while reusing shared ingestion, scheduling, lineage and access controls.
At Flatiron Health, I built pluggable ingestion and analytical interfaces and integrated clinical ML/NLP into oncology data workflows.

expertise.title: Distributed Systems & Real-Time Streaming

expertise.title: Data Platforms & Knowledge Engineering

expertise.title: LLM Systems & Agent Orchestration
expertise.body: Application-level Coordination with an OSS Deep Agent, Retrieval MCP tools and LangGraph state; bounded context and calls, model route selection and explicit failure handling.

expertise.title: Retrieval & RAG

expertise.title: AI/LLM Evaluation
expertise.body: Separate checks for application behavior, retrieval relevance, generated-answer quality and artifact review; versioned drafts, evidence, task-specific criteria and owner decisions guide revisions.

expertise.title: Reliability, Observability & Release Engineering
expertise.body: Data-freshness and consumer-lag SLOs, distributed tracing, diagnostic automation and incident recovery; containerized services, validated knowledge releases, conditional activation and rollback.

expertise.title: Regulated Data & Engineering Productivity
expertise.body: Financial and healthcare pipelines with access controls, audit trails and data lineage; reusable AI-assisted diagnostic workflows connected to monitoring, CI/CD and ticketing.
